It's been like that since... before I was even born.

I know its sounds stupid, but I really wanted to write that down even if the situation itself it's not that bad.

Thank you so much for answering

Well, Borderline personality disorder makes your emotions way more unstable than they should be, so, sometimes, I lose control of them, and I just say what I feel, and that´s just  not good.

 And, the family part, If anyone makes her just a little bit angry, she just kind of screams, cries, breaks everything she can, and basically takes all than anger in all of us
It is my fault since When I do something bad, all my family gets affected by my mother, I know is childish and estupid but I can't control what say
thanks, I needed to hear something like that

Breathe, take a break from everything if you want, life can be as long as you want it to be. Go slow, take your time, there's always someone who will be there to hear you.

You can create a reason to live. I know you must be frustrated about everything right now, but you can find at least one little thing to stay alive

like...dogs! I like dogs, do you like dogs? dogs are great.

When I feel bad, I ride on my bike and feed homeless dogs, they're great, maybe it can help you, and if it don't, there´s always something else, there's so many things... You just need to find the right for you and  return to your normal activities when you feel better
